title: SearchReplacePreviewFrame
description: `POST /search/replace/preview`: one line of the NDJSON stream (plan 11, B-11, D-02) — the same search as `search.text.frame`, with the resolved replacement text on every match and the file's own ETag. In the domain this is a discriminated union by `type` (`file` carries `path`/`etag`/`matches`; `end` carries `truncated`/`skipped`; `error` carries `code`/`messageKey`/`params`), which the generator cannot express as a `oneOf`; flattened here, with the pairing documented per field (plan 28, B-48). The stream always ends with exactly one `end` or `error` line.

path.description: Present exactly when `type` is `file`. Relative to the folder, with /.

etag.description: Present exactly when `type` is `file`. The sha256 of the content this preview read — the version the apply flow checks against (S-81).

preview.description: A window around the match, cropped to a ceiling (S-66) — the "before" of the diff.

previewMatchStart.description: Where the match starts inside preview, in UTF-16 units.

previewMatchEnd.description: Where the match ends inside preview, in UTF-16 units.

replacement.description: What this one match's text becomes — group references and "preserve case" already resolved (S-82, S-97). The client builds the "after" by splicing this in place of preview[previewMatchStart:previewMatchEnd].

skipped.description: Present exactly when `type` is `end`. Files the engine reported as binary, excluded from the results (S-67).

params.description: Present exactly when `type` is `error`. Open: the parameters of the message, by key.
